# Test Fixtures Directory

Contains deterministic synthetic fixtures generated by `generate_fixtures.py`:
- `synthetic_plane`: 100x75 grid at Z = 2.0m with calibrated 65°C thermal block.
- `occlusion_scene`: Foreground box at Z = 1.0m (85°C) in front of background wall at Z = 3.0m (20°C).
Run `python tests/fixtures/visualization/generate_fixtures.py` to regenerate.
